Group.title: Protect Accounts by Restricting Password-Based Login
Group.description: Overly-simple or commonly-used passwords provide attackers with access to systems.

Rule.title: RHEL 9 must enforce a minimum 15-character password length.
Rule.description: The minimum password length must be at least 15 characters.
Rule.fixtext: Configure RHEL 9 to enforce a minimum 15-character password length by setting PASS_MIN_LEN to 15 in /etc/login.defs.

Rule.title: RHEL 9 must limit the number of concurrent sessions to 10.
Rule.description: Operating system management includes the ability to control the number of users and user sessions that utilize an operating system.
Rule.fixtext: Configure RHEL 9 to limit the number of concurrent sessions by adding: * hard maxlogins 10 to /etc/security/limits.conf.
